kevin: Heads-up — billing dashboard shows ~30% higher token consumption for streaming requests yesterday. Might be retries + tool calls. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: Yep, saw the spike around 03:12 UTC. Example id `r-9a4`: initial stream sent ~120 tokens, client retried twice, tool call generated ~80 tokens, but dashboard shows ~320 tokens.

samir: Are we double-counting streamed chunks and then also summing final transcripts? We currently emit realtime events on each chunk AND a final `session_end` event, which could be duplicated.

jordan: @samir we increment `tokens_reported` on each websocket chunk ack so quota is realtime-friendly. Then billing job aggregates events for invoice. If dedupe isn't perfect, sums can be higher.

kevin: Pasting relevant logs for r-9a4 (sanitized):

```
[1765234567] stream_chunk ack r-9a4 chunk=1 tokens=45
[1765234570] stream_chunk ack r-9a4 chunk=2 tokens=75
[1765234588] retry detected r-9a4 idempotency=null
[1765234592] tool.call start t-33 tokens_in=10
[1765234595] tool.call end t-33 tokens_out=70
[1765234600] usage_event increment tokens=320
```

lina: This also shows up in the rollout console — canary for model variant `m-lite` shows a weird usage jump and on-call got paged. Console makes it look like model is expensive.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: rolled back model-router change at 1765234700 by @samir due to anomalous usage spikes.

ops-bot: quota-alert: @kevin dev team exceeded realtime-quota by 18% at 1765234682.

samir: Proposal: canonicalize a single source-of-truth for billable tokens. Approach: emit incremental 'reported' events for realtime quotas but mark them with `stream_id`, `chunk_index`, and `idempotency_key`. The billing/reconcile job dedups events by idempotency keys (or stream+index). Retries must reuse the same idempotency key.

maria: Sounds good but many SDKs don't send idempotency keys today. Server should synthesize one on session start and return it in the handshake. Also consider server-side heuristics (payload hash + short time window) to dedupe old clients.

jordan: UX idea for Console: show two columns in telemetry — `reported` (what quotas used in realtime) and `committed` (what billing will charge after reconciliation). Add 'pending tokens' for open streams so SREs see drift.

kevin: Edge case: tool-calls that spawn sub-requests to external providers — we currently attribute both top-level and tool-sub-request tokens. Fix: attribute tool-call tokens to parent request id and mark internal tool tokens as non-billable duplicates unless the tool is explicitly billable.

maria: Implementation sketch: 1) server assigns idempotency_key if absent and returns it on handshake; 2) stream chunks emit `reported` events that are provisional; 3) on session close we emit a `commit` event which billing job uses as final; 4) reconcile job dedups by idempotency_key + chunk_index.

samir: One concern: if we hold off billing until commit, quotas may let users exceed hard limits. Alternative: provisional quota subtraction at report-time, with final reconciliation adjusting balances (refunds or add-backs). Need policy for refunds & metrics.

jordan: +1 to provisional quotas. Also need to update internal API: add header `X-Redwood-Idempotency` and document in SDKs. We'll need a migration plan so older clients don't get charged twice during rollout.

lina: Add tests for these scenarios: stream+retry, stream+toolcall, truncated stream (client cancels mid-stream). Expected outcome: billed tokens == committed final tokens.

maria: I'll prepare a fuzz trace generator and a reconciliation integrator. Quick curl example for handshake/service header: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Idempotency: abc123" -d '{"model":"m-lite","prompt":"hi"}'
```

kevin: I'll draft an RFC covering telemetry, billing, and rollout UX. Owners: @maria telemetry + dedupe job, @samir billing + router, @jordan console. Anyone want to take SDK migration updates?

lina: I can own SDK changes for JS + Python. Will add automated test matrix.

kevin: Great. I'll circulate RFC link when it's ready. For immediate triage: Maria, can you add a short query to detect sessions missing idempotency keys so we can measure impact?

maria: On it — will post metrics in #eng-platform in an hour. :mag:
